title: Assess eager idle source snapshots if synchronous native capture latency warrants it
outcome: Use measured clean native opening-capture dispatch latency to decide whether eager idle S0 is justified; preserve BEFORE timing, exact authority and no late credit without adding an unnecessary lifecycle subsystem.
acceptance: Record complete clean native S0 and prompt-dispatch latency on Questly and Phoenix with exact installed executable identity; distinguish source-only timings, workload and unknowns.

Decide explicitly whether eager idle preparation is warranted compared with synchronous bounded capture; if adopted, independently concur on BEFORE semantics, one-shot identity/watcher fences, bounded dispatch and no late credit before implementation.
